sources.title: From Synthea to ICD-10: Building a Medical Coding ML Pipeline on GCP
sources.snippet: A BERT-based model gives you richer features, but richer features don't help a classifier that's only seen a code three times. Swapping architectures would have been treating the wrong layer of the stack. So the transformer went on the backlog, and I turned to the failures themselves — which is where the project got interesting.

sources.snippet: Synthea TM is a Synthetic Patient Population Simulator. The goal is to output synthetic, realistic (but not real), patient data and associated health records in a variety of formats.
